svg.title: Sources and evidence
svg.desc: How can a result be traced or checked? Tracing origin and derivation, opening underlying cases, and assessing evidence answer different checking questions. Source illustration: The design card places a supporting source passage and its citation beside the implication.

text.tspan: How can a result be traced or checked?
Connects a result to its sources, supporting evidence or underlying
cases, so people can trace where it came from and check its basis.
Claim linked to a source passage
Recorded form · FC010: Drill-down from summary to underlying instances (VA012).
